page_topic_one_liner: Google Tag Manager — container setup, tags, triggers, variables, data layer, and analytics/marketing tag deployment

visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): GTM-style admin workspace mockup — left nav with Tags / Triggers / Variables tabs (icon + blur labels), main panel showing tag list rows with status dots and one highlighted tag row with accent border, container ID blur GTM-XXXXXXX at top
Secondary: data layer flow diagram — website page box → dataLayer.push event arrow → tag firing icons (GA4, pixel blurs as generic colored squares, no real logos)
Tertiary: preview/debug mode panel overlay — connected status indicator and event log rows (blurred)
anti_patterns: LLM chat panel as hero (this is GTM not GEO)
Real Google Tag Manager or Google logo
Generic Google Analytics dashboard without container/trigger/variable structure
Affiliate or CRM UI unrelated to tag management
